title: Nocturnal animals
examples: How do bats fly at night?
Do all animals that are awake at night live in the dark?

explain.say: Some animals are active at night. They are called nocturnal animals. They sleep in the day.
Owls have very big eyes. Their eyes help them see in the dark.
Bats make sounds that bounce off things. They listen to the echoes to find their way.
Foxes often come out in the evening and at night. They have a very good sense of smell.

items: Out at dusk and at night

explain.say: Owls use their eyes. Bats use their hearing. Foxes use their senses too.
Nocturnal means an animal is mostly active at night.

faq.q: Why do owls have such big eyes?
faq.a: Owls have large eyes because they need to collect as much light as possible. This helps them see clearly when it is very dark outside.
asks: How do owls see in the dark?
Are owl eyes bigger than human eyes?

faq.q: What is echo location for bats?
faq.a: Echolocation is when bats make sounds and listen for the echoes. It helps them find their way in the dark.
asks: How do bats navigate without light?
Do bats use sound like sonar?

faq.q: Are all animals that are awake at night mammals?
faq.a: No. Owls are birds, and moths are insects. Many nocturnal animals are not mammals.

faq.q: Are foxes always active at night?
faq.a: Foxes are often out at dawn and dusk, as well as at night.
asks: Do foxes only come out at night?

faq.q: What is the main difference between a bat and an owl?
faq.a: The main difference is how they find food. Owls rely mostly on their excellent eyesight, while bats use sound echoes.
asks: Do bats see better than owls?
What sense do they use most?

facts: Bats use sound waves for navigation.
Foxes are known for being clever hunters.
Nocturnal means active at night time.

quiz.say: Which night animal finds its way with very big eyes?
quiz.why: An owl's big eyes take in lots of light, so it sees in the dark.

wrong.0: A bat finds its way by listening to echoes.
wrong.2: A fox uses its strong sense of smell.

quiz.say: Which sense do bats use to find their way in the dark?
quiz.why: Bats make sounds and listen for echoes. That is hearing.

wrong.1: Taste helps with food, but it cannot find the way.
wrong.2: Bats fly through the air, so touch is too slow to find the way.

quiz.say: An animal sleeps in the day and is busy at night. What is it called?
quiz.why: Nocturnal animals are busy at night and sleep in the day.

wrong.0: Hungry means it needs food, and that can be at any time.
wrong.1: Many nocturnal animals are not mammals, like owls.
